[1/2] Plan: keep the COMMERCE exchange first and collapse auto-trade plus quantum freight below it

impact_assessment.why: COMMERCE is the next densest core tab at 2076px; the auto-trade broker and quantum freight sit between the services row and the market, so the exchange and its price rows never reach the first screen at 1280x720.
impact_assessment.benefits: The market table becomes the primary surface, the broker and freight stay one click away, and dense service/filter/market rows stop overflowing at 1280.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI surface; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: hidden attributes and existing trade state only, no save change; regression: the exchange, services and both disclosures must stay reachable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static disclosure/order tests, before/after height and width measurements, open-state browser play, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

[1/2] Plan: collapse FLEET mercenary contracts and procurement, and keep contracts available with zero drones

impact_assessment.why: FLEET is the last dense core tab at 1271px; mercenary contracts and the commission catalog are always expanded and push the escort manager below the fold, and renderFleet returns early with zero drones so the hiring contracts vanish.
impact_assessment.benefits: The default FLEET view drops below 1000px with the active fleet and escort manager visible; contracts and procurement stay one click away; hiring survives an empty drone roster.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI surface plus one render-path fix; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: hidden attributes and existing fleet state only, no save change; regression: both disclosures and the zero-drone roster must stay reachable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static disclosure/zero-drone tests, before/after height and overflow measurements, real-browser reveals and a drone-dismissal play, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: FLEET condensation verified: 1271px to 957px, contracts/procurement disclosures, zero-drone hiring preserved; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-fleet-disclosures' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: give every left tab the same compact header, section rhythm and readable narrow rows

impact_assessment.why: All 16 left tabs were measured at 1280x720: headers ranged 46-136px because 17px titles wrapped and actions fell to extra rows, DEPOT squeezed item names into one-word columns, EMPIRE research names into ~80px, and STORY clipped a faction name.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every tab starts at the same 56px height with a single-line title; section headings match; depot, research and story rows become fully readable; three content tabs shrink further.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI surface and static copy; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (CSS/HTML/JS layout only); regression: dynamic long titles ellipsize but keep a hover title, and shortened intros retain the full text in title attributes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static uniformity test, a 16-tab browser sweep with header/title/list assertions, before/after vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Left-panel uniformity verified: 16/56px headers, 16/16 one-line titles, readable depot/research/story rows; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-left-panel-uniformity' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: make ARSENAL, FACTIONS and CODEX summary-first and give small-card lists a shared rhythm

impact_assessment.why: The largest left surfaces are ARSENAL 6509px, FACTIONS 4594px and CODEX 10683px, and QUESTS/AI/MESSAGES cards range from 44px to 436px, so the advanced terminal still overwhelms at a glance.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each advanced tab opens at under 600px with counts and section headers visible; catalogs stay one click away; small cards share minimum heights and compact actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI surface and static counts; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: hidden attributes only, no save change; regression: filters, counts and all list controls must stay reachable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static condensation test, a browser sweep of all six disclosures and card distributions, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.

checkpoints.description: Advanced condensation verified: ARSENAL/FACTIONS/CODEX under 600px collapsed, all lists reopen, cards share rhythm; checklists: passed

[1/2] Plan: clamp the radar scale label and shorten only the Battle Focus chip display label

impact_assessment.why: At 1280x720 the scale label centers under the left drawer and loses its R, while the Battle Focus chip name ellipsizes to 'Battle Fo...' in the 70px ability column.
impact_assessment.benefits: The radar label is fully readable on short scale bars and the sixth ability set has no truncated chip, with the full Battle Focus name retained in the tooltip.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD canvas/JS; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; regression: the label must stay within the map inset and the chip label must remain understandable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static label test, canvas instrumentation in a real-browser play, before/after vision review, 16-tab sweep and full gates.

checkpoints.description: HUD polish verified: RANGE SCALE fully visible, six chips unclipped, Focus title retains Battle Focus; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-hud-polish' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: make reactor doctrine presets the default onboarding path and tuck manual sliders behind FINE TUNE

impact_assessment.why: The always-visible reactor strip shows four sliders, four doctrine buttons, a duplicate BALANCED/SPEED/SCIENCE row and an APPLY ROUTE button that is not visible at 1280x720; the academy tells players to adjust sliders, and choosing a doctrine preset does not advance the power step.
impact_assessment.benefits: The default strip shows only heat, doctrine presets and output; one ECONOMY/OVERDRIVE click completes the power milestone with its reward; manual routing stays available under FINE TUNE.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: reactor tutorial progression and UI layout; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock held; state: no new save field; regression: route_power and slider apply must still work and not double-award.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first engine test, one-click browser play with a second mode change, fine-tune open/close check, vision review, UI snapshot and full gates.
